entities.name: Sulfotransferase 2A1
observations: The 284-residue query sequence is an exact full-length sequence match to reviewed Rattus norvegicus UniProt P15709.
Cytosolic/cytoplasmic enzyme that uses 3'-phospho-5'-adenylyl sulfate (PAPS) as the sulfonate donor.
Catalyzes sulfation of steroid, sterol, bile-acid, alcohol, phenol, and xenobiotic substrates; exact substrate breadth is context-dependent.
Reported as a homodimer in the matched reference annotation.

entities.name: SULT2A1 sequence properties
observations: Length 284 aa; calculated molecular mass 33,134 Da; theoretical pI 8.52; predicted net charge at pH 7 approximately +2.9.
Sequence-derived instability index is 25.6 and GRAVY is -0.211; these are computational estimates for the unmodified monomer.

entities.name: Steroid and bile acid metabolism
observations: Sulfotransferase 2A1 contributes to steroid, cholesterol, and bile-acid metabolic processes through sulfate conjugation.
Sulfation generally increases aqueous solubility and facilitates excretion, but can activate some xenobiotic metabolites.

entities.name: PAPS metabolic process
observations: The enzyme binds PAPS and transfers its sulfate group to hydroxyl-bearing acceptors, producing a sulfate conjugate and PAP.

entities.name: Sulfotransferase domain architecture
observations: Pfam detected Sulfotransfer_1 (PF00685) at residues 33-276 and Sulfotransfer_3 (PF13469) at residues 98-205.
The domain architecture supports classification as a cytosolic sulfotransferase, consistent with the exact sequence match.
